page.layout: One block of verse, one printed page: running head at top centre, page number at top right, text in lines below. No notes, no catchword.

main_text.p:
Votisque semper supplicibus colis,
Quod inssa seruas, & potenti
Tegeris vsque Deo minorem.
Quid tuta virtus praesidio Patris
Possit supremi, quid queat indoles
Addicta Christo, Principisque
Quid valeant pia vota iusti
Hostilis ardens agminis impetus
Sensit retusus nuper, & aemulae
Sensere, quae tristi cohortes
Cortracia cecidere pugna:
Sensitq; Ductor, funera qui tibi
Audax parabat dura Iovesivs:
Quum vota risisset piorum
Sollicitasque preces superbus.
Nam victa spreto Numine brachiis
Fidens iuventus cum Duce corruit:
Vicitque caelestem precatus
Miles opem metuendus hosti.
Sic praepotenti Iessaides prece
Pugnauit olim, quum rudis agminum
Fudit Philistaeas phalanges,
Atque trucem feriit Gigantem:
Quem mole vasta corporis ardui
Armabat ensis, cuspis & anea
Ingentis hastae: cuique pectus
Aere ferox solido micabat.
Hic fastuoso lumine militem

page.notes: Verse lines are printed in italic with long s rendered as s; some words are doubtful: "Cortracia" and "Iessaides" as printed. Line-initial capitals of several lines are set in larger italic and read as printed.
